description.shortText: An economic framework that responds to individualized demands, acting upon actual individual intentions instead of vying for the attention of many. While altering the traditional supply-demand relationship, the intention economy can empower consumers to take a more proactive role in the market.

attachments.name: Consumers have huge environmental impact: We like to blame the government or industries for the Earth's problems, but what we buy makes a big difference.
attachments.description: You won't make big cuts in your environmental impact by taking shorter showers or turning out the lights. The real environmental problem, a new analysis has shown, is embodied in the things you buy.
